question: Compare the straight-line distance in kilometers between Barranquilla and Mérida and between Cusco and Ufa.
sql:
SELECT 'Barranquilla–Mérida' AS pair, ST_Distance_Spheroid(a.geometry, b.geometry)/1000 AS distance_km
FROM populated_places a, populated_places b
WHERE a.name='Barranquilla' AND a.country='Colombia' AND b.name='Mérida' AND b.country='Mexico'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Cusco–Ufa', ST_Distance_Spheroid(a.geometry, b.geometry)/1000
FROM populated_places a, populated_places b
WHERE a.name='Cusco' AND a.country='Peru' AND b.name='Ufa' AND b.country='Russia'
ORDER BY pair;

question: List populated places within 1000 km of Cusco, with their distance in kilometers, ordered by distance.
sql:
WITH cusco AS (
  SELECT geometry FROM populated_places WHERE name='Cusco' AND country='Peru'
)
SELECT p.name, p.country, ST_Distance_Spheroid(p.geometry, c.geometry)/1000 AS distance_km
FROM populated_places p, cusco c
WHERE NOT (p.name = 'Cusco' AND p.country = 'Peru')
  AND ST_Distance_Spheroid(p.geometry, c.geometry) <= 1000000
ORDER BY distance_km, p.name, p.country
LIMIT 20;

question: Give me the area in square kilometers of the convex hull of all populated places in Colombia.
sql:
WITH pts AS (
  SELECT ST_ConvexHull(ST_Union_Agg(geometry)) AS geom
  FROM populated_places
  WHERE country='Colombia'
)
SELECT ST_Area_Spheroid(geom)/1e6 AS area_km2
FROM pts;

question: What is the length in kilometers of a straight line between Bobo Dioulasso and Barranquilla?
sql:
SELECT ST_Length_Spheroid(ST_MakeLine(a.geometry, b.geometry))/1000 AS length_km
FROM populated_places a, populated_places b
WHERE a.name='Bobo Dioulasso' AND a.country='Burkina Faso'
  AND b.name='Barranquilla' AND b.country='Colombia';

question: Give me the area in square kilometers of the bounding box of all populated places in Mexico.
sql:
WITH bbox AS (
  SELECT ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) AS geom
  FROM populated_places
  WHERE country='Mexico'
)
SELECT ST_Area_Spheroid(geom)/1e6 AS area_km2
FROM bbox;
